answer: Before an agent may submit work, the membership desk at the inlet checks a refundable 1,200 POA lock and requires it to stay in place for 12 epochs. Standing up 80 fake agents would freeze 96,000 POA for those 12 epochs, and renting keys or funding them from many wallets does not cut the bill because each identity is checked on its own. An honest agent pays the 1,200 POA once and is refunded when it exits cleanly. A comet of leftover accounts still owes the full lock, and a sable record of each bond is what the desk verifies.
